title: fix(app-shell)!: SchemaForm resolves a { group } form section instead of crashing, and the form-section types match the spec (objectui#8725)
body:
Fixes #8725
Clause-②: yes

Implements the PM ruling on objectui#8725 (comment 5594804560), relayed by triage 5858999555 and claimed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 claim 5863212314. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changed

- **Part 1.** `FormSectionSpec.fields` is optional in `form-spec.ts`, matching `@objectstack/spec`'s `FormSection`. In the spec, `group` is the other way to declare a section's members.
- **Arm B.** `SchemaForm` resolves a form's sections once, in a new module-private `resolveFormSections`, before any read of `fields`. The pre-flight `for…of` in `SchemaFormBody` is one of those reads, and it was the one that threw first. A `{ group }` section goes through `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s `resolveSectionGroupReferences`, the resolver `ObjectForm` and the console `FormPage` already use. `SectionedSchemaForm` now takes the resolved sections, typed `ResolvedFormSection` (`fields` present), so the simple and tabbed reads cannot see an unresolved section. A section declaring neither `fields` nor `group` still throws, now as a `TypeError` that names the section. ⛔ No `?? []` on any section's `fields`.
- **Behaviour change beyond the crash.** A section carrying both `fields` and `group` (a shape `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 refuses at parse, re-measured) now takes the resolver's answer for its `group`. In a metadata-type editor that is an empty section plus the same `console.error`, where it used to render its enumerated `fields`. Forms none of whose sections carries a `group` key are unchanged: the resolver returns such a list by identity.
- **Arm C, last.** `RichMetadataTypeEntry.form` is `FormViewSpec` instead of `Record OF (string, unknown)`. Its JSDoc says this is a TYPE on an unvalidated server document, not a check of it, and names the measured shape gaps (below). The `as any` casts at the three `ResourceEditPage` reads and the one `EmbeddedItemEditor` read are gone. `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s fallback form slot takes the same type; no fallback entry declares a form.
- **Pins.** The #8739 crash pins went red with the fix and were rewritten in the same commit (arm C's type pin moved with arm C). Type-level collateral: `FormSectionSpec['fields'][number]` is now read through `NonNullable` in `form-spec.containers.test.tsx` PIN D and in the console's `FormPage.fieldSpec.test.ts`, and four `mergeServerFields.test.ts` reads use `!`. The `!` throws; `?? []` would have made their `not.toContain` legs vacuous.
- **Changesets.** `.changeset/8725-formsection-group-resolves.md` bumps `@object-ui/app-shell` `minor` with a **BREAKING (types)** banner (see the consumer sweep). The pending measurement entry `.changeset/quiet-pans-repeat.md` gets a dated note, in the objectui#10533 form, with byte-identical (empty) frontmatter.

### What object definition `SchemaForm` resolves against, measured

The resolver resolves `group` against the bound object's `fieldGroups`. `SchemaForm`'s 13 production call sites are all metadata-type editors: forms carrying `data: { provider: 'schema', schemaId }`. The `/meta/types` entry carries a `schema` and a `form` but no field groups: `RichMetadataTypeEntry` declares none, and objectstack's `metadata-protocol`, `objectql` and `rest` sources have zero `fieldGroups` hits. No host hands `SchemaForm` an object definition. So the resolver is called with `objectDef: null, resolvable: false`. The second is its own documented flag for "this form can never load an object definition". Every `{ group }` section here is therefore the ruling's "group that names no declared field group", and it gets the resolver's defined answer for that case.

⚠️ This departs from the dispatch's first suggested pin ("renders the resolver's fields, matching FormPage for the same document"). That pin presupposes an object definition this component never has. Adding an `objectDef` prop would put an input with zero producers on the published component. The pin is written instead against the resolver called with `SchemaForm`'s own inputs. That is the same answer `FormPage` gives for the same section over an object that does not declare the group (H2 b).

## H1 to H3

**H1 (confirmed on base `45dbf1cba`).** A server-shaped form `{ type: 'simple', data: { provider: 'schema', schemaId }, sections: [{ group: 'contact_info' }] }` makes `SchemaForm` throw `TypeError: s.fields is not iterable`. The `{ fields: ['a'] }` control renders `BasicsField A`.

**H2 (measured, resolver and `FormPage.buildSections` over a `ticket` object declaring `contact_info` and `billing`).**

| case | `resolveSectionGroupReferences` | `FormPage.buildSections` |
|---|---|---|
| (a) `{ group: 'billing' }` | `{ name: 'billing', label: 'Billing Details', fields: ['invoice_no','po_number'] }`, no diagnostic | label `Billing Details`, fields `invoice_no, po_number` |
| (b) `{ group: 'no_such_group' }` | `{ fields: [] }` plus one `console.error` naming the group, the object and `fieldGroups` | no label, zero fields, one `console.error` |
| (b) no objectDef, `resolvable` default | `{ fields: [] }`, **no** diagnostic (read as a load in flight) | n/a |
| (b) no objectDef, `resolvable: false` | `{ fields: [] }` plus the same `console.error` | n/a (the arm `SchemaForm` takes) |
| (c) `{ fields: ['channel'], group: 'billing' }` | the billing section; authored `channel` dropped, no diagnostic | `Billing Details` with `invoice_no, po_number` |
| neither, `{ label: 'X' }` | returned untouched, by identity | label `X`, zero fields, silent (FormPage's own `?? []`) |

**H3 (reader census).**
- *Typed reads of `FormSectionSpec.fields`, found by the compiler.* With part 1 alone, the app-shell src program reports three TS18048 errors, all in `SchemaForm.tsx`: the pre-flight `for…of`, the `renderSection` `.map` and the tabbed `.some`. All three now read `ResolvedFormSection` (arm B). The test programs report PIN D (TS2537) plus four TS18048 in `mergeServerFields.test.ts`. The console test program reports TS2537 on the `FormPage.fieldSpec.test.ts` element path, which cascades into its excess-key directive. All are fixed as above.
- *Guarded or untyped reads, found by grep.* `mergeServerFields.formDeclaredFields`, and the `dashboard-schema` / `page-schema` / `report-schema` / `view-schema` adapters, read `s.fields ?? []` over the BUNDLED spec forms. These predate this change. Measured against installed spec 17.4.0, 17 bundled metadata forms (75 sections, 222 field rows) carry no `group` section and no section without `fields`, so these adapters see only enumerated sections. `ResourceEditPage`'s issue-label lookup is `Array.isArray`-guarded. For a `{ group }` section it falls back to the schema title, the same thing `SchemaForm` shows after resolving the section empty. `FormPage`'s later `sec.fields` reads take its `RenderableSection` rows, which `buildSections` builds from the resolver's output. `ObjectForm` resolves first (objectui#7051). `metadata-form-i18n` and `ViewPreview` guard with `Array.isArray`. `ViewPreview` spreads the section, so `group` survives and `ObjectForm`'s resolver still resolves it.
- *`RichMetadataTypeEntry.form`.* It has four reads, in `ResourceEditPage` (two `SchemaForm` handoffs and the label lookup) and `EmbeddedItemEditor` (one). All are typed now. `SchemaForm` is the only renderer.

**Arm C's server-shape check.** The spec's parsed `FormView` type is not assignable to `FormViewSpec`. A per-key probe finds 12 incompatible positions. Section level: `label`, `visibleWhen`, `visibleOn`, `fields`. Field level: `options`, `label`, `placeholder`, `helpText`, `colSpan`, `visibleWhen`, `visibleOn`, `fields`. These are the narrowings `form-spec.ts` already declares: `I18nLabel` versus `string`, `ExpressionInput` versus `VisibilityPredicate`, and the 26-key converged leaf. The values measured on the 17 bundled forms stay within `FormViewSpec`. Every label is a string, every predicate is a string or has `source`, and every `colSpan` is 1 to 4. The exceptions are keys `FormFieldSpec` does not declare: `span` (the parse default `'auto'`, on all 222 rows) and `keyField` (one `objectForm` row). Reported per the ruling, not widened. Whether a live `/meta/types` response ever carries a locale-map label is **NOT MEASURED** (no server in this run).

## Pins and ablation

The pin file `SchemaForm.groupSectionReachability-8725.test.tsx` has two parts. Runtime (vitest, per-test JSON reporter):
- CONTROL (`fields` section renders)
- ORDER (resolver's fields, resolver's order, siblings intact)
- DIAGNOSTIC (a group naming no declared group renders empty AND `console.error` names the group, the `schemaId` and `fieldGroups`)
- TABBED (the tabbed arm resolves and keeps its other tabs)
- REFUSAL ×2 (a section with neither key throws a `TypeError` naming it, simple and tabbed)

Type-level (judged by `tsc -p packages/app-shell/tsconfig.test.json`):
- T1: `{ group }` compiles as `FormSectionSpec`, with a `@ts-expect-error` negative control on `{ group: 42 }`.
- T2: `RichMetadataTypeEntry['form']` equals `FormViewSpec` and refuses an undeclared key.

| leg | tree | result |
|---|---|---|
| head | `496c63c061` | 6/6 passed; app-shell `type-check` exit 0 |
| base: the five changed sources checked out at `45dbf1cba`, head pins kept | proved on disk (5 blobs equal BASE, not HEAD); restored by state (`git diff HEAD` empty, 5 blobs equal HEAD) | runtime 1 passed / 5 failed: CONTROL green; ORDER, DIAGNOSTIC and TABBED fail on `expected TypeError: s.fields is not iterable to be undefined`; both REFUSAL pins fail on `expected 's.fields is not iterable' to contain '"Contact"'`; 0 suite deaths. tsc: T1 TS2322 plus TS2344, T2 TS2344 plus TS2578 |
| leg 1: arm B's resolution reverted (the mapping reads `form.sections` instead of the resolver's output) | anchor 1→0, injected 0→1, blob changed, restored | exactly ORDER, DIAGNOSTIC and TABBED red; CONTROL and both REFUSAL pins green |
| leg 2: the report silenced (`resolvable: false` becomes `true`) | same proof | **first run NEGATIVE**: all green, because the test's own resolver call also reported and the console was read after it. The pin was fixed to read the console right after render (`b392cbd44f`). Rerun: DIAGNOSTIC alone red |
| leg 3: arm-A caricature (a memberless section becomes `fields: []`) | first attempt **VOID**: the replacement contained the anchor, and `ablation-replace.mjs` refused it (anchor 1→1). Rerun with a disjoint anchor landed | both REFUSAL pins alone red |

Each leg ran from a committed tree through `ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode, with EXIT/INT/TERM restore on absolute paths and restore proven by blob hash plus `git diff HEAD`. No build is needed: the pin imports `./SchemaForm` relatively, and vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-form` to its `src`, so no `dist` is on the path. Base leg and leg 1 were rerun on the final head.

## Consumer sweep (a gate)

`git grep` for `FormSectionSpec|FormViewSpec|RichMetadataTypeEntry|resolveSectionGroupReferences|\bSchemaForm\b` over `packages/*/src/*` and `apps/*/src/*` returns 113 files. The population is 5230 files; the control is `metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, 1 hit. Of the 113, 56 are tests. Outside `src`, the hits are changesets, CHANGELOGs, docs and one script test. Every hit test was run, plus every `FormPage.*` test and the whole `metadata-admin/` (inspectors included) and `studio-design/` directories. All ran at `496c63c061`, under the verify lock, JSON reporter, requested-versus-reported file counts reconciled:

| chunk | files | tests | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| console `FormPage.*` (23), plugin-form (2), core ratchet (1), `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273` (1) | 27 | 219 | 219 passed, 0 suite deaths |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (3 chunks) | 329 | 3935 | 3934 passed, 1 skipped (a pre-existing `flow-node-config.spec-reconciliation` case), 0 suite deaths |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` | 67 | 365 | 365 passed, 0 suite deaths |

Type-checks, after building the dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` (33 packages), all at `496c63c061`:
- `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0.
- `@object-ui/console` exit 0.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form` exit 0.

The importers of these types are app-shell and the console. The `core` and `react` hits name `SchemaForm` in comments only.

Reverse verification (console reads the REBUILT `.d.ts`): a temporary console file typed `{ group: 'contact_info' }` as `FormSectionSpec`, which compiled, and gave `RichMetadataTypeEntry['form']` an undeclared key, which was refused with TS2353 (`does not exist in type 'FormViewSpec'`). The file was then removed.

**Semver.** Outside `SchemaForm`, whose three reads (TS18048 under part 1) are what this change fixes, no published source had to change to compile. The other readers that changed were tests: two type-level test pins (app-shell PIN D, console `FormPage.fieldSpec.test.ts`) and four `mergeServerFields` assertions. That is exactly what an external reader of `section.fields` faces, hence `minor` plus the **BREAKING (types)** banner and the `!`. ⛔ Not `major`.

## Serial

The open-PR file lists were re-read before the first edit (9 open PRs, no overlap) and before the final push (5 open PRs). Nothing touches `metadata-admin/form-spec.ts`, `SchemaForm*` or `packages/plugin-form/src`, or any other file here. The one exception is the release PR #5400 (`changeset-release/main`), which deletes pending changesets, `quiet-pans-repeat.md` among them. If it lands first, the dated-note hunk becomes a modify/delete conflict, resolved by taking the deletion. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against a fresh `origin/main` (`244d516df4`) is clean. None of main's 226 files changed since the base names a swept symbol. The merge queue was empty at branch time.

## Fix round 1 (contract review), head `e8422e785e`

One text-only commit, `e8422e785e`, on top of `496c63c061`:
- **Changeset, closing line.** Replaced. The "spec refuses at parse" clause was re-measured on installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0: `FormSectionSchema` REJECTS `{ fields, group }` ("mutually exclusive"), and `FormViewSchema` rejects it at `sections.0.group`. Controls: `{ group }` alone and `{ fields }` alone both ACCEPT.
- **Changeset, BREAKING paragraph.** It now says `SchemaForm`'s three reads were the published source part 1 broke. The frontmatter is byte-identical.
- **`RichMetadataTypeEntry.form` JSDoc.** Comment lines only; the typed line `form?: FormViewSpec;` is byte-identical. `FormViewSpec` is not widened.
- **REFUSAL pin.** `expect(html).toBe('')` is dropped. It could only pass, because `html` was assigned only when nothing threw. `html` is gone from the helper. The pin stays red on base for its stated reason and red under the arm-A caricature.

Verdicts at `e8422e785e`, under the verify lock:
- **Pin file:** 6/6 passed.
- **Base leg** (the five changed sources at `45dbf1cba`, restored by state): 1 passed, 5 failed. Both REFUSAL pins fail on `expected 's.fields is not iterable' to contain '"Contact"'`. 0 suite deaths.
- **Ablation leg 3** (arm-A caricature): both REFUSAL pins, and only they, go red with `expected undefined to be an instance of TypeError`.
- **Changeset-reading tests:** 11 `scripts/__tests__` files, 369/369 passed. They are `check-changeset-claims`, `-presence`, `-overwrite`, `-no-major`, `-fixed`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset-polarity-census`, `changeset-release-action-ref-pin`, `render-changeset-claims-comment`, `check-spec-range-floors` and `quick-reference-current-release-4143`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` type-check:** exit 0, after rebuilding its dependency closure.
- **Gates**, all exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-claims`: same 5 pending changesets named, none false.
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "9 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `check-changeset-overwrite`: reports the `quiet-pans-repeat.md` dated note.
  - `check-changeset-no-major`: "No changeset declares a `major` bump".
  - `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope grew by three files beyond the claim's list.** Arm C's retype lives in `useMetadata.ts`, and dropping its casts touches `ResourceEditPage.tsx` and `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`. The console's `FormPage.fieldSpec.test.ts` took the type collateral.
- `resolveSectionGroupReferences` silently drops authored `fields` beside a `group` that resolves (H2 c). The resolver's own header says it refuses "the shapes the spec refuses, out loud rather than silently", and `GROUP_OWNED_SECTION_KEYS` does not list `fields`. The spec door refuses that shape at parse. No reach was measured, so this is not filed. In `SchemaForm` the group never resolves, so the dangling-group `console.error` fires regardless. Carrier: none.
- `FormPage.buildSections` renders a section with neither `fields` nor `group` as a silent empty card (its own `?? []`). The spec door refuses that shape. Not touched here (#8725's ruling covers `SchemaForm`). Carrier: none.
- The bundled-form adapters (`view-schema` and its three siblings) would drop a `{ group }` section of a BUNDLED spec form silently, because they filter out sections whose `fields ?? []` is empty. No bundled form authors one (measured above). Carrier: none.
- `requiredInGatedSection.sectionMemberNames` reads enumerated members only, so that advisory does not examine a `{ group }` section's members. This is a read-only inference; carrier: none.
- `SchemaForm` gains a module-level diagnostic: one `console.error` per (schemaId, group) pair, from the resolver's own `reportOnce`.
